text:
iOS: initial release for iOS. Initial release of GH Todos, a focused todo app built on GitHub Projects.

Connect with a GitHub token, choose your projects, review priority- and due-date-aware issues, add new tasks, update details, comment, and close or reopen items from one streamlined interface.

• Add the new iOS Home Screen widget to see tasks at a glance, switch projects, refresh, and mark items complete.
• Tap GitHub task-list checkboxes in issue descriptions and comments to update them directly.
• Markdown lists now continue automatically while writing issues and comments.
• Improved reliability across supported platforms.
